C-67.Name: Sidebar Recent: a «Clear Recent» broom in the section header, like «Close all» on Opened files
C-67.Summary: User request 2026-10-19: the sidebar Recent section can only drop files one by one; add a header action that clears the whole list, revealed on header hover like the Opened files «Save all / Close all» icons, with a broom glyph.

Problem.Description: Clearing Recent means removing every row by hand. The backend already has mt_recent_clear (M-017) and the renderer facade ipcRecent.clear, unused in the UI.

Goals.R-1: The Recent section header shows a broom button on hover / keyboard focus (title and aria-label «Clear Recent», ten locales). Click clears the shared recent list via ipcRecent.clear and empties the section (which then hides); a backend failure still empties the local rows and logs [SideBar][clearRecent][BLOCK_RECENT_CLEARED] persisted=false.
Goals.R-2: A «broom» glyph in chromeIcons, same 16-grid stroke family.
Goals.R-3: Unit tests: button present with labels, clear call, section hides, failure path; icon registry pin updated. grace lint 0.

Constraints.Item: No new backend command; no confirmation dialog (the list rebuilds as files are opened).

AcceptanceCriteria.Criterion: R-1..R-3 done; tests green; grace lint 0; live check: hover the Recent header, click the broom, Recent disappears.

VerificationIntent.ExpectedEvidence: Unit pins for the clear call and the failure path; screenshot of the hovered header.
